[Intro: blaring horn fanfare loop, go-go drums, male voice]
Yes. History in the making, part two
Tell them

[Hook: female lead, wordless chant over horns]
Oh no, oh no, oh no, no-no
Oh no, oh no, oh no, no-no

[Verse 1: female lead, quick and precise]
I had a five-year plan and a filing system
Colour-coded Sundays, never missed one
Then you said my name like a song I knew
Now I'm barefoot on a table and it's quarter past two

[Pre-Chorus: drums roll, harmonies stack]
I don't do this, this isn't me
Ask anybody, ask my family

[Chorus: full power, horns, the chant answers]
Look what you've done to me
Kicked off my sensible shoes
Look what you've done to me
I've got nothing left to lose
Got me acting like a rumour
Got me dancing like the news
Look what you've done
I kicked off my sensible shoes
(Oh no, oh no, oh no, no-no)

[Verse 2: female lead, laughing through it]
I used to check the weather, I used to read the label
Now I'm ordering dessert before I'm even at the table
My mother says "who is this?" and my sister says "at last"
I say I'm only passing through, and I'm not moving fast

[Pre-Chorus: drums roll, harmonies stack]
I don't do this, this isn't me
Ask anybody, ask my family

[Chorus: full power, horns, the chant answers]
Look what you've done to me
Kicked off my sensible shoes
Look what you've done to me
I've got nothing left to lose
Got me acting like a rumour
Got me dancing like the news
Look what you've done
I kicked off my sensible shoes
(Oh no, oh no, oh no, no-no)

[Rap Verse: male guest, relaxed, horns drop to bass and drums]
She had a planner, I had a plan, and neither one survived
Showed up to say hello and now I'm learning how to jive
I'm a grown man with a mortgage and a lower-back complaint
Doing moves from ninety-seven like a saint without restraint
They said act your age, I said which one, I've had a few
The best of them's the one I'm having standing next to you

[Bridge: half-time, strings, voice soars]
And I could put them on again
I could find the door
But I like the floor beneath my feet
I never felt the floor before

[Final Chorus: horns, key hits, big ad-libs and runs]

Kicked off my sensible shoes
Look what you've done to me
I've got nothing left to lose
Got me acting like a rumour
Got me dancing like the news

I kicked off my sensible shoes

Oh no, oh no, oh no, no-no
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 99 BPM, 4/4, D minor. A strutting, syncopated funk groove. Brassy, urgent and joyful.

VOICE: A female lead with a huge, agile voice: rapid, rhythmic and exact in the verses, full-throated in the chorus, with gospel runs and shouted ad-libs at the end. She also sings the wordless chant, stacked into a gang. A male guest raps one verse in a relaxed, conversational baritone.

INSTRUMENTS: A sampled-style horn section playing a blaring, triumphant fanfare on a loop. Go-go style live drums with rolling toms and a cowbell. A deep, bouncing bass. Handclaps. A string section in the bridge. Stabbing rhythm guitar low in the mix.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the horn fanfare and a spoken introduction. 0:10 Hook, the wordless chant. 0:20 Verse 1. 0:39 Pre-chorus. 0:49 Chorus 1. 1:13 Verse 2. 1:32 Pre-chorus. 1:42 Chorus 2. 2:06 Rap verse, horns out. 2:30 Bridge, half time with strings. 2:50 Final chorus with ad-libs. 3:19 Outro, fanfare and chant fading by 3:40.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2000s R&B built on an old soul sample: gritty horns, punchy live-sounding drums, a polished modern vocal on top.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The horn fanfare in the first second.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: Both singers are adults with plans, mortgages and bad backs. The recklessness is chosen, late, and enjoyed, and the bridge makes clear she could stop and does not want to.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Mock alarm, delight, a guest's agreement, then full commitment.
